issues.quote: Revenue rose 0.9% to $97.7 million in fiscal 2024
issues.problem: Wrong unit: Tesla's FY2024 revenue was about $97.7 billion, not million.

data.summary: The analysis is mostly accurate, but it has one error. It gives Tesla's FY2024 revenue as $97.7 million when the correct figure is about $97.7 billion. The other figures check out: gross profit ($17.4B vs $17.7B), gross margin (17.9%), operating income ($7.1B vs $8.9B), operating margin (7.2%), R&D spending ($4.5B vs $4.0B), net income (down 52.7% to $7.1B from $15.0B) and diluted EPS ($2.04 vs $4.30).
